title: The past-ruling judge counts only an owner ruling, never an incident or a recommended pick
why: Two false alarms of the Stop hook's past-ruling guard on Nov 8. (1) Coordinator 11:38 CST: it told lane silent-undo-reads-retire-run (session_013NEJL4TDRWqka4aSU2Bv7L) that step mixed-merge-resolver holds a coordinator ruling that "the orchestrator resolves it by hand", but that step's own why calls the hand merge an incident against roles-orchestrator-never-builds; the lane followed it and pushed a hand merge (1a444eb96 on #1932). (2) Triage 10:51 CST: it read item 431's recommended `pick` as the owner's answer, though the page held no answer. Fix: the judge cites a ruling only from an owner answer or a sentence that names the owner as its source (premise P44 test), never from an incident, a recommendation or a coordinator note.
